summary: A 3U CubeSat that images the Lake Erie western basin to track harmful algal blooms.

parameters.name: altitude_km
parameters.rationale: Stated: 500 km sun-synchronous.

parameters.name: life_years
parameters.rationale: Stated: two-year life.

parameters.name: array_area_m2
parameters.rationale: Stated: two body-mounted panels, 0.06 m2 in total.

parameters.name: cell_efficiency
parameters.rationale: Stated: 29 percent cells.

parameters.name: tx_power_w
parameters.rationale: Stated: 2 W S-band transmitter.

parameters.name: data_rate_kbps
parameters.rationale: Stated: 1 Mbps downlink.

parameters.name: launch_limit_g
parameters.rationale: Stated: keep it under 5 kg.

parameters.name: solar_constant_w_m2
parameters.rationale: The person said to keep the solar constant fixed.

parameters.name: frequency_mhz
parameters.rationale: S-band was stated. 2250 MHz is a common space-to-Earth allocation.

parameters.name: rx_gain_dbi
parameters.rationale: A 3 m dish was stated. At 2250 MHz and 55 percent efficiency that is about 35 dBi.

parameters.name: elevation_deg
parameters.rationale: A typical minimum elevation for a fixed ground station.

parameters.name: slant_range_km
parameters.rationale: Range from 500 km altitude at 10 degrees elevation.

parameters.name: pointing_factor
parameters.rationale: Body-mounted panels on a nadir-pointing 3U average well under full sun.

parameters.name: sunlit_fraction
parameters.rationale: Typical for a 500 km orbit that is not dawn-dusk.

parameters.name: bus_load_w
parameters.rationale: Orbit-average load of a 3U imaging bus without the transmitter.

parameters.name: bus_dry_mass_g
parameters.rationale: A 3U bus with payload, without panels and added shielding.

parameters.name: propellant_mass_g
parameters.rationale: A small cold-gas load for orbit maintenance.

parameters.name: maturity
parameters.rationale: A design at this stage is past estimates and short of measured hardware.

parameters.name: shield_mm
parameters.rationale: Typical aluminum-equivalent shielding inside a 3U structure.

parameters.name: temp_min_c
parameters.rationale: Common electronics lower limit.

parameters.name: temp_max_c
parameters.rationale: Common electronics upper limit.

requirements.text: The solar array shall cover the orbit-average load with at least 10 percent margin at end of life.
The spacecraft mass with growth allowance shall not exceed the 5000 g launch limit.
The downlink shall carry 1 Mbps with at least 3 dB of margin at minimum elevation.
Every part shall survive the two-year mission dose with a radiation design margin of at least 2.
The bulk temperature shall stay between the minimum and maximum allowed in the hot case.

parameterization_notes: Every stated number is a parameter, so another mission can change it.
The solar constant stays a fixed constant, as instructed.
Gaps are filled with typical 3U values and tagged ai.
open_questions: Is 10 percent the power margin your program requires?
What is the dry mass of the bus you intend to buy?
